title: CloakFEM: Agentic FEM Code Generation for Red-Teaming Computational Resource Exhaustion
title_zh: CloakFEM：面向计算资源耗尽红队测试的智能体式有限元代码生成

paragraphs.en: 提出CloakFEM框架自动生成对抗性有限元程序，最极端情况下求解器迭代放大5752倍，揭示效率攻击面。 Finite element method (FEM) solvers are foundational to scientific and engineering simulation, yet their susceptibility to \emph{efficiency attacks} remains largely unexplored. An adversary can craft syntactically valid and runnable FEM programs that complete successfully while forcing excessive computational work, enabling computational denial-of-service (DoS) attacks. Finding such inputs is challenging because FEM programs occupy a vast, structured space constrained by numerical, geometric, and constitutive requirements. We introduce CloakFEM, a domain-guided LLM-agent framework for automatically generating runnable adversarial FEM programs that amplify solver computation. CloakFEM combines LLM-guided search with an FEM-specific intermediate representation and a deterministic validity gate that enforces runnable constraints. Across three FEM stacks, 17 problem classes, and 1,068 seeds, CloakFEM discovers adversarial inputs that substantially amplify solver work while remaining valid and solvable. In the most extreme case, solver iterations increase from 43 to 247,367, a \(5{,}752.72\times\) amplification. CloakFEM outperforms five generic black-box baselines and retains an advantage over evolutionary search under a controlled bounded action space. Cross-solver analysis further reveals both problem-intrinsic and solver-specific sources of vulnerability. Our results uncover an underexplored efficiency-attack surface in FEM solvers and show that runnable FEM programs can serve as adversarial inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 提出CloakFEM框架自动生成对抗性有限元程序，最极端情况下求解器迭代放大5752倍，揭示了效率攻击面。有限元方法（FEM）求解器是科学与工程仿真的基础，但其在效率攻击面前的脆弱性却在很大程度上未被探索。 攻击者可以构造语法有效且可运行的FEM程序，这些程序能够成功完成求解，同时迫使求解器执行过多的计算工作，从而实现计算拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。 寻找此类输入极具挑战性，因为FEM程序占据一个广阔且结构化的空间，受数值、几何和本构要求的约束。 我们提出CloakFEM，这是一个由领域知识引导的大语言模型智能体（LLM-agent）框架，用于自动生成可运行的对抗性FEM程序，以放大求解器的计算量。 CloakFEM将大语言模型引导的搜索与FEM专用的中间表示以及强制执行可运行约束的确定性有效性门控相结合。 在三个FEM软件栈、17类问题和1,068个种子上，CloakFEM发现的对抗性输入在保持有效且可求解的同时，大幅放大了求解器的计算工作量。 在最极端的情况下，求解器迭代次数从43增加到247,367，放大了5752.72倍。 CloakFEM优于五个通用的黑盒基线方法，并且在受控的有界动作空间下仍相对演化搜索保持优势。 跨求解器分析进一步揭示了问题固有和求解器特定的两类脆弱性来源。 我们的结果揭示了FEM求解器中一个未被充分探索的效率攻击面，并表明可运行的FEM程序可以作为对抗性输入。
